## Regions Financial Corp. to Participate in Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference


Nov 9, 2026


*Comments will be available through a live webcast.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Financial Corp.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54636917&newsitemid=20261109658360&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Financial+Corp.&index=1&md5=e0685c416e2afc88f94ffb797d31525a) (NYSE:RF) on Monday announced the company is scheduled to participate in the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference on Wednesday, Dec. 9, 2026.


Regions’ portion of the conference will begin at approximately 9:20 a.m. ET on that date. Executives from the bank will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator.


The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format. To access the discussion, visit Regions’ Investor Relations page at[https://ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com&esheet=54636917&newsitemid=20261109658360&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com&index=2&md5=95372880e26baa0d4c3ca302f928f9b4) . A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event.


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $163 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54636917&newsitemid=20261109658360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=3&md5=fb5c408bc8ad9002d84c73702b3cc250) .
